items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 0.8% in 1985 to 1.1% in 2025 across 39 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

25 of 39 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 10 for salt or chloride; 25 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
1 of 39 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 10 of 10 high-need ones have none.
